# Image generation guide (ChatGPT / DALL·E / Sora Image)

The portraits shipped with the repo (`public/assets/portraits/*.svg`) are
**provisional emblems generated by code**. This guide is for replacing them with
real illustrations while keeping the app's visual coherence.

---

## 1. Style bible

The reference is the **Persona 5** interface: dirty comic art, thick ink, blood
red on black, diagonal and aggressive composition.

| Axis | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Technique | Vector illustration / hard cel-shading. No 3D render, no photorealism. |
| Line | Thick, irregular black outline, like an inked brush. |
| Shadows | Two tones per area at most. Flat shadow, no soft gradients. |
| Palette | Charcoal black `#08070A`, bone `#F6F1E6`, blood red `#E01133` and **one** accent color per class (table in section 4). |
| Background | Abstract: halftone dot patterns, diagonal bands, ink splatter. Never a detailed landscape. |
| Framing | Medium close-up (waist or chest up), character turned slightly, looking at camera. |
| Attitude | Cover pose: hip turned, shoulder forward, an emphatic gesture. |
| Texture | Printed paper grain and a slight ink misregistration. |

**Hard rules**

- **Diagonal** composition: the body axis falls between 8° and 15° off vertical.
- The character takes up **70–80 %** of the canvas height.
- The **bottom third** must stay reasonably empty or in shadow: the app draws the
  name and class over it.
- High contrast. If the silhouette does not read when the image is shrunk to
  130 px wide, the image is no good.

---

## 2. Technical specs

| Use | Ratio | Minimum size | File name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Character portrait | 5:7 vertical | 1000 × 1400 px | `public/assets/portraits/<slug>.png` |
| Title screen background (optional) | 16:9 | 2560 × 1440 px | `public/assets/bg-title.png` |

- **PNG** format (or WebP). No watermarks, no frames, no text inside the image.
- Leave **8 % safe margin** on every side: the card is shown rotated −3° and
  clips the corners.
- Compress before committing (target: < 300 KB per portrait).

---

## 3. Base prompt (fill in the `[brackets]`)

```
Fantasy character illustration in a Persona 5 / screen-printed poster comic style.

SUBJECT: [species] [gender] D&D [class], [distinctive physical trait],
[clothing and armor], wielding [characteristic weapon or object].
Expression [attitude: defiant / serene / mocking / ferocious].

COMPOSITION: medium close-up, body turned about 12° off vertical, shoulder
forward towards camera, looking at the viewer. The character takes up 75 % of the
height. Bottom third in flat shadow, no detail.

STYLE: hard two-tone cel-shading, thick irregular black ink outline, comic
halftone dots, diagonal bands in the background, ink splatter, printed paper
texture with slightly misregistered color.

PALETTE: charcoal black, bone white, blood red and [class accent color] as the
only saturated color. Four colors total at most.

FORMAT: vertical 5:7 canvas, abstract background (never a landscape), no text,
no frame, no signature.
```

### Negative prompt (if the tool takes one)

```
photorealism, 3D render, soft shading, gradients, pastel colors, moe anime,
text, letters, logos, watermark, frame, signature, deformed hands,
detailed landscape background, full-body framing, landscape orientation
```

---

## 4. Accent colors per class

Use exactly these codes: they are the same ones that tint the menu when a
character is selected (`src/data/rules.ts`).

| Class | Accent | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Barbarian | `#E03A2F` | `barbarian.png` |
| Bard | `#D8478F` | `bard.png` |
| Cleric | `#E8C15A` | `cleric.png` |
| Druid | `#4FAE62` | `druid.png` |
| Fighter | `#B9411F` | `fighter.png` |
| Monk | `#37B6C4` | `monk.png` |
| Paladin | `#DCAE3C` | `paladin.png` |
| Ranger | `#3F8F6D` | `ranger.png` |
| Rogue | `#6F7CD1` | `rogue.png` |
| Sorcerer | `#E2593F` | `sorcerer.png` |
| Warlock | `#8B46D6` | `warlock.png` |
| Wizard | `#3F7BD6` | `wizard.png` |

## 5. Ready-to-paste examples

**Wizard**

```
Fantasy character illustration in a Persona 5 / screen-printed poster comic style.
SUBJECT: middle-aged elf wizard, white hair tied back, a burn scar at the temple,
long high-collared robe with stitched runes, holding an open tome that levitates
and sparks. Serene, arrogant expression.
COMPOSITION: medium close-up, body turned 12°, shoulder forward, looking at the
viewer, takes up 75 % of the height, bottom third in flat shadow.
STYLE: hard two-tone cel-shading, thick black ink outline, halftone, diagonal
bands in the background, misregistered printed paper texture.
PALETTE: charcoal black, bone white, blood red and blue #3F7BD6 as the only saturated color.
FORMAT: vertical 5:7, abstract background, no text, no frame, no signature.
```

**Barbarian**

```
... SUBJECT: goliath barbarian woman with grey mottled skin, shaved head with
tribal tattoos, furs and bone pauldrons, a greataxe resting two-handed on her
shoulder. Ferocious expression.
... PALETTE: charcoal black, bone white, blood red and red #E03A2F as the only saturated color.
```

**Rogue**

```
... SUBJECT: tiefling rogue woman with curved horns and a visible tail, hood
pulled low, half a smile, two curved daggers crossed at the chest, coins falling
from one hand. Mocking expression.
... PALETTE: charcoal black, bone white, blood red and violet #6F7CD1 as the only saturated color.
```

---

## 6. How to get the images into the app

1. Save the PNG in `public/assets/portraits/` with the name from the table in section 4.
2. If you replace an existing portrait (same name, extension `.svg` → `.png`),
   update the extension in two places:
   - `PORTRAIT_SLUGS` / `portraitForClass()` in `src/data/defaults.ts`
   - `PORTRAIT_LIBRARY` in `src/sections/IdentitySection.tsx`
3. For a portrait of one specific character (not of a class), no code change is
   needed: on the sheet, section **Identity → Portrait → Upload**. The image is
   stored as a data-url next to the character.

> Once Supabase is connected, that button will upload the file to a Storage
> bucket and store only the public URL. See `docs/SUPABASE.md`.

---

## 7. Checklist before calling an image done

- [ ] The silhouette reads at 130 px wide.
- [ ] The bottom third has no important detail (the name covers it).
- [ ] There is only one saturated color besides red/black/bone.
- [ ] No text or frame inside the image.
- [ ] Exactly 5:7 ratio and under 300 KB.
